name: vdm
description: SDLC workflow plugins: docs-sync (documentation synchronization), docs-distill (synthesis layer — the summary view that is rebuilt, not appended to; drift signal on `covers:` frontmatter), learn (knowledge capture), changelog (project change tracking), crystal-* (workitem discipline gate — grow/bud/cut/cave + migrate for batch legacy-doc onboarding), intercom (central cross-agent/cross-session message store with an agent directory — canonical identity + the names the user says, kept complete by a SessionStart check), wrap (before a clean session: sweep the chat for what exists only in it, write each item where the next session reads it, one commit, a start phrase with a slug).
